title: Soul Factory Communikeys community membership provisioning
observed_behavior_before: SoulFactory could assign newly provisioned identities to configured NIP-29 groups.
SoulFactory did not update Communikeys kind-30000 section profile lists.
SoulFactory configuration and Signet-step output had no Communikeys community assignment surface.
intended_behavior: Configuration identifies controller-owned Communikeys communities by community pubkey and section names.
After Signet identity provisioning, SoulFactory reads the latest valid admin-authored kind-30000 list for each exact section coordinate through EOSE.
SoulFactory preserves the list, appends the agent p tag when missing, republishes a controller-signed replacement, and requires relay OK.
Missing lists, invalid controller ownership, relay AUTH failures, and relay rejection fail provisioning closed.
Assigned kind-30000 coordinates are recorded in the Signet provisioning step; badges never grant write permission.
